7.13.1 Development Errors
[SWS_Dem_00173] Definition of development errors in module Dem Upstream requirements: SWS_BSW_00050, SWS_BSW_00212
⌈
Type of error Related error code Error value API function called with a parameter value, which is not allowed by active configuration DEM_E_WRONG_CONFIGURATION 0x10 API function called with a NULL pointer DEM_E_PARAM_POINTER 0x11 API function called with wrong parameter value DEM_E_PARAM_DATA 0x12 API function called with wrong length parameter value DEM_E_PARAM_LENGTH 0x13 Dem initialisation failed (refer to [SWS_BSW_ 00151]) DEM_E_INIT_FAILED 0x14 API function called before the Dem module has been full initialized (refer to [SWS_Dem_ 00124],[SWS_Dem_00364]) or after the Dem module has been shut down (refer to [SWS_Dem_ 00368]) DEM_E_UNINIT 0x20 Required conditions for the respective API call are not fulfilled (e.g. an invalid status change was initiated, or a filter was not set correctly, etc. - refer to [SWS_Dem_00518]). DEM_E_WRONG_CONDITION 0x40 Dem_DcmGetAvailableOBDMIDs called with invalid OBDMID. DEM_E_INVALID_OBDMID 0x50
⌋
[SWS_Dem_00124] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406
⌈If DemDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE and any Dem API excluding :
• Dem_SetEventStatus
• Dem_ResetEventStatus
• Dem_SetEventAvailable
• Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus
• Dem_GetVersionInfo
• Dem_MainFunction
• Dem_InitAllNvmBlocks is called before Dem has been fully initialized, the Dem module shall set the error code DEM_E_UNINIT.⌋ Note: If development error detection is disabled and the Dem is not fully initialized, the behavior of the APIs is undefined.
[SWS_Dem_01324] ⌈During Dem_Init the Dem initializes the monitor and component states. After this point in time, the Dem shall return E_OK on the APIs Dem_GetMonitorStatus and Dem_GetComponentFailed.⌋
